discrepancy_D001.title: Cold-Start Compilation Overhead
discrepancy_D001.impact: First inference call incurs ~340ms graph setup; subsequent calls execute in ~16ms.
discrepancy_D001.mitigation: 10 mandatory warmup cycles executed during server bootstrap.

discrepancy_D002.title: 1D Vertical Infiltration Boundary
discrepancy_D002.impact: Excludes 2D/3D overland lateral flux routing along steep topological valley slopes.
discrepancy_D002.mitigation: Acceptable for root-zone moisture (z <= 20cm); lateral routing scheduled for Phase 2.

discrepancy_D003.title: Satellite Revisit Cadence Asymmetry
discrepancy_D003.impact: Thermal (16-day) and meteorological (24-48h delay) do not align with Sentinel 5-day cycle.
discrepancy_D003.mitigation: Handled via Optional[Tensor] parameters with zero-downtime graceful degradation.

discrepancy_D004.title: Constant Dirichlet Boundary Approximation
discrepancy_D004.impact: PINN model checkpoint trained under fixed boundary conditions (theta_top=0.35, theta_bottom=0.15).
discrepancy_D004.mitigation: EnKF state assimilation dynamically compensates for prior model divergence, squashing variance by -64.0%.

discrepancy_D005.title: Cloud Shadow Attenuation
discrepancy_D005.impact: QA60 detects cloud bodies; shadows occasionally attenuate optical reflectances.
discrepancy_D005.mitigation: Fully bypassed by microwave SAR amplification branch (1.35x boost), transparent to clouds and shadows.

discrepancy_D006.title: Spatial Soil Texture Homogeneity Assumption
discrepancy_D006.impact: Single tile assumed uniform texture class; sub-pixel texture gradients approximated by regional mean.
discrepancy_D006.mitigation: HWSD regional lookup database; multi-texture spatial masking scheduled for Phase 2.

discrepancy_D007.title: Extreme Climatological Exchangeability Drift
discrepancy_D007.impact: 500-year catastrophic flash floods may temporarily violate calibration exchangeability assumptions.
discrepancy_D007.mitigation: Intercepted immediately by Bit 3 (High Epistemic Risk) and Bit 4 (PDE Violation) in anomaly bitmask.

discrepancy_D008.title: Float32 Numerical Precision in Deep Unsaturated Zone
discrepancy_D008.impact: In hyper-arid soils (theta -> theta_r), matric suction head approaches 10^7 cm.
discrepancy_D008.mitigation: Suction head numerically clamped to 10^6 cm (100 kPa tension limit), preventing float overflow.
